title: Rationalize client bindings: coordinated minor dependency bumps and API surface slimming
creator: Priya Nair
description: Coordinate minor dependency upgrades across Python, JavaScript, and Go client libraries while removing small, deprecated API fields that increase maintenance surface. Primary goals: (1) bring transitive dependency trees in line with CI gates to reduce build noise and CVE churn; (2) remove legacy params and thin compatibility shims that are no longer used by product routes; (3) ship language-specific compatibility shims and migration notes so downstream customers have a predictable upgrade path. Work includes cross-repo branch coordination, CI benchmark runs, semantic versioning decisions, and a staged rollout with feature-flagged client behavior to avoid user impact.
acceptance_criteria: All three language clients (python/js/go) have coordinated minor dependency bumps and pass full CI (unit + integration + e2e).
Deprecated API parameters documented and removed from public surface; compatibility shims implemented for one release where removal is breaking.
Changelog entries and migration notes published in docs and release notes for each client.
Benchmarks show no >10% regression in common tokenization/latency paths after dependency bumps.
A canary rollout plan exists and the Console/Telemetry team has dashboard panels to monitor errors/tokenization anomalies during the rollout.
steps: Inventory current dependency trees for python/js/go clients and list version deltas and CVEs
Identify deprecated API fields used by internal callers and customer routes via code search and usage telemetry
Draft compatibility shim design (single-flag opt-in shim, removed after one minor release)
Open coordinated PRs in each client repo with pinned minor bumps and updated changelogs
Run CI benchmarks (latency, memory, startup) and compare against baseline
Ship behind feature flags; coordinate with rollout team and Console for observability
Publish migration guide and mark deprecated fields in docs; schedule follow-up task for final removal
comments: 2025-02-12 Priya Nair: Kicked off inventory. Found python has two transitive protobuf versions causing CI flakiness; js uses an older fetch polyfill that conflicts with new bundler. Planning per-repo PRs next week.

2025-02-20 Design review (Lina Patel): Confirmed we can remove 'response_format_hint' parameter from high-level helpers; product routes confirmed no active usage. Will add shim for one release to translate the old field to structured output calls.
